paragraphs.text: He exhorts them to repentance to avoid all these plagues, exhorting them to declare by words their obedience and repentance.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: return unto the LORD thy God

paragraphs.text: He shows them that they ought to confess their sins.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Declaring that this is the true sacrifice that the faithful can offer, even thanks and praise; He 13:15.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: We will forsake all vain confidence and pride.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He declares how ready God is to receive those that do repent.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Whoever unites themselves to this people will be blessed.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: God shows how prompt he is to hear his own when they repent, and to offer himself as a protection and safeguard for them, as a most sufficient fruit and benefit.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Signifying that the true wisdom and knowledge consists in this, even to rest upon God.
paragraphs.label: h
